system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.
region_name: Global land areas with valid daily nighttime observations

data_description.dataset_name: NASA VIIRS Black Marble VNP46A2 Daily Nighttime Lights

spatial_coverage.region_name: Global land areas with valid daily nighttime observations
spatial_coverage.coverage: Near-global daily nighttime radiance over land, subject to clouds, snow, lunar conditions, viewing geometry, and retrieval-quality screening.

analytical_capabilities: Mapping daily BRDF-corrected nighttime radiance and its spatial distribution
Constructing location-specific seasonal and pre-event radiance baselines
Detecting abrupt radiance departures and estimating their onset, depth, duration, and spatial extent
Comparing anomaly trajectories across neighborhoods, regions, and repeated events
Auditing cloud, snow, ephemeral-light, lunar, and gap-filling effects with the supplied quality layers

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Nighttime DNB radiance in nanowatts per square centimetre per steradian
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Prefer DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL for observed radiance and use Mandatory_Quality_Flag, QF_Cloud_Mask, Snow_Flag, and Latest_High_Quality_Retrieval to define valid samples. Treat gap-filled values separately and compare dates against a matched local baseline rather than raw global thresholds.

data_description.data_source: NASA VIIRS Land Science Investigator-led Processing System and Black Marble product team
